title: France probes judicial 'dysfunction' after suspected murder of 11‑year‑old Lyhanna
summary: The French government is set to probe what President Emmanuel Macron on Friday described as "dysfunction" in the judicial system following the suspected killing of an 11-year-old girl named Lyhanna in southwest France. The main suspect in the case had twice been formally accused of raping a child, with investigations either dropped or stalled.
